title: Alkahest Drops block file (format 1)
description: A file in data/<namespace>/block_drops/: a drop file (drops) or a removal file (removals), never both. Docs: https://jaffh-dev.github.io/alkahest-wiki/mods/alkahest-drops/

$schema.description: This schema, for editor autocomplete. Ignored by the game.

entity.description: Block files use block; entity is for mob_drops files. The file is skipped.

drops.description: The drops this file adds. A drop file must not also have removals.

on.description: Triggers are for mob files only. The file is skipped.

removals.description: A file is either a drop file or a removal file. The file is skipped.

dropBehavior.description: How the count is chosen inside count: uniform, fixed_rolls, chained_rolls or hardness.

type.description: uniform: any count from min to max. fixed_rolls: a fixed number of independent rolls. chained_rolls: rolls until the first failure. hardness: scales with the block's hardness.

drop.description: One drop. Needs item (or "experience": true), chance, count and drop_behavior. Blocks drop only with a tool that can harvest them.

item.description: Item to drop. An item of a mod that is not installed skips the drop with a warning.

experience.description: true makes this an experience drop: count is the amount of experience. Only player breaks with a harvesting tool drop experience.

functions.description: Loot functions applied to the dropped stack, in order, after count and nbt.

first_break.description: Drop once per player, the first time, ignoring the chance.

first_kill.description: Mob files only: block files use first_break (ignored, warning).

on.description: Triggers are for mob files only (error).

interval.description: Triggers are for mob files only (ignored).

cooldown.description: Triggers are for mob files only (ignored).

function.description: looting_enchant reads the killer, which block drops never have (warning).
